name: box-spanner
description: Tubular box spanner 14 x 15 mm, DIN 896 form B, zinc-plated steel (Hornbach article 8839238)

frame.origin: centre of volume, close to the middle of the tube
frame.z: the axis of the tube, pointing towards end A, the 14 mm socket, which is up when the stamped markings read the right way; end B (15 mm) is at -z
frame.x: from the axis towards a corner of the hexes, which are aligned with each other; hole A runs along x
frame.y: z cross x; hole B runs along y

symmetry.rotation: 2-fold about z (180 degrees): the hexes and the through holes all survive a half turn
symmetry.flip: none: the two ends differ (14 versus 15 mm) and the holes are crossed

source.kind: generated from calliper measurements of the real part; no downloaded geometry

measured_mm.socket_depth: equal to the outside hex length

assumed.inner_corner_rounding: outer rounding minus the wall thickness

to_verify: blend length between hex and tube, by eye against reference photos (not included)
mass on a scale (steel would give about the value printed by the build)
